name: @e2e-dev/argent-testbed
description: Runs the SwiftUI example's locator tests on an Argent Cloud simulator

scripts.build:app: xcodebuild build -project ../../examples/with-swiftui/HelloApp.xcodeproj -scheme HelloApp -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -quiet
